title: Female Representation in Local Authorities
description: Proportion of women and men in Malaysian local authorities.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency.

fields.name: female
fields.title: Women
fields.description: [Float, %] Women as a percentage of total filled positions

fields.name: male
fields.title: Men
fields.description: [Float, %] Men as a percentage of total filled positions

methodology: This dataset is compiled from official records of Malaysian local authorities as of January 1st each year. The proportions of women and men are computed using the total number of filled positions as the denominator, meaning that vacancies are not included.
caveat: The data reflects the composition of local authorities at the start of the year. Therefore, it does not capture any changes in composition that occur during the year. However, the proportions usually do not fluctuate significantly.
